## introspect

Emit the machine-readable CLI surface.

```
Usage: relay introspect [options]

exit codes, and examples. This output is the T2_CLI authority source; it is
derived, never authored.

Options:
  --json      emit JSON (the only supported format)
  -h, --help  display help for command

Examples:
```
